tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Whose bag is this?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. For a person or an animal, add 's to the name or noun (Priya's bag, the twins' birthday). When there is an of tile, you are talking about a thing: the end of the film.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: 's for people and animals, of for things: 'the end of the film'.
